name: google-ads-management
description: Ongoing, cadence-based Google Ads management as done-with-you advisors — dual input (read-only Google Ads MCP or a user CSV export), fronted by an interactive in-Claude menu: invoke 'manage Google Ads' to open the `google-ads` hub, which lists every task and routes to it. A shared foundation (account selection, GAQL cookbook, 2026 benchmarks, dual-input + advisor output contract) plus account health & red flags, budget pacing, bidding strategy, keywords/search terms, Quality Score forensics, audience targeting, conversions & tracking, performance reporting, competitive analysis, PMax campaigns, PMax listing groups, and product performance. Diagnoses account data against thresholds behind a transcription firewall, then leads a prioritized recommendation loop and offers ready-to-apply Google Ads Editor CSVs — emitting the md + interactive-HTML + tunable-xlsx bundle (or a reduced md + xlsx bundle for account health & audience targeting), with Node<->Python kernel parity across every tunable skill.
